ارتقبا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَبَا (irtaqabā) /ir.ta.qa.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اُرْتُقِبَا (urtuqibā) /ur.tu.qi.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اِرْتَقِبَا (irtaqibā) /ir.ta.qi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
